problem.title: Jet transport as a compatibility condition indexed by the divisibility poset
problem.user_statement: A numerical method is a single map per dimension: it receives a component count and a right-hand side, and nothing else. A Weil algebra A of dimension N turns a system on R to the n into one on A to the n, which — once a basis of A is fixed — is simply R to the nN. So jet transport is not a method acting on some enriched space; it is a compatibility condition relating two levels of one family, phi n and phi nN, through the lift map f maps to f A. The characterization comes from taking that seriously. A fixed R to the m receives one such condition for every factorization m = nN and every Weil algebra of dimension N, all of them landing on the same map phi m. This turns the family into an object indexed by the divisibility poset, with the algebras as edges, and it supplies the tools: how the conditions restrict along divisors, how they compose under tensor products, how the automorphisms of each algebra act, and — the point of interest — what happens where two different lift structures on the same R to the m have vector fields in common, since there phi m receives two prescriptions at once.
problem.current_statement: A numerical method is a family Phi = (phi_n)_{n>=1}, phi_n a function of (n, f) alone for f: R^n -> R^n a right-hand side. A Weil R-algebra A with dim_R(A) = N and f: R^n -> R^n induce the lift f_A: A^n -> A^n; fixing an R-basis of A gives A^n =~ R^{nN}, so (A^n, f_A) becomes an input (nN, f_A) to phi_{nN}. For each n and each Weil algebra A of dimension N, this defines a compatibility condition C(n,A) relating phi_n(f) and phi_{nN}(f_A) for all f. Phi 'supports jet transport' iff C(n,A) holds for every n and every Weil algebra A. Fixing m and ranging over factorizations m = nN and Weil algebras A of dimension N gives every condition bearing on phi_m, organizing the family as a diagram over the divisibility poset (N, |), with a Weil algebra of dimension N giving an edge n -> nN. Round 1 tests, as one package: (a) restriction of {C(n,A)} along divisor chains n | n' | m; (b) composition under tensor product (does C(n, A tensor B) relate to C(n,A) and C(nN_A,B) as edge composition n -> nN_A -> nN_A N_B?); (c) the action of Aut_{R-alg}(A) on C(n,A), and whether C(n,A) is well-defined independent of the chosen basis; (d) [point of interest] when R^m carries two distinct lift structures with vector fields in common, whether the two resulting prescriptions on phi_m are forced to agree.
problem.intent: Find the correct characterization of jet-transport-compatible numerical methods as a poset-indexed compatibility structure, and locate where it breaks (gaps, counterexamples, or ill-posedness) rather than prove it outright.
